all-dependencies: The request body loginRequestDTO is required;
In loginRequestDTO, username and password must be provided together (if one is present, the other is required);
The request body createOrUpdateUserDTO is required;
In createOrUpdateUserDTO, username and password must be provided together (if one is present, the other is required);
The request body role (string) is required;
Both path parameters roleId and permissionKey must be provided together;
For addPermissionOnRole, the pair (roleId, permissionKey) must not already be associated on the role;
Both path parameters roleId and permissionKey must be provided together;
For removePermissionOnRole, the pair (roleId, permissionKey) must already be associated on the role;
The request body registerUserAccountDTO is required;
In registerUserAccountDTO, username, password, and email must all be provided together (if any one is present, the others are required);
Both the path parameter id and the request body updateUserDTO must be provided together;
Both path parameters id and roleId must be provided together;
For addRole, the pair (id, roleId) must not already be associated for the user;
Both path parameters id and roleId must be provided together;
For removeRole, the pair (id, roleId) must already be associated for the user;
